bio: I'm Sultan Mahmud — Saad — a hardware engineer in Dhaka, Bangladesh. I studied Electrical and Electronic Engineering at Gono Bishwabidyalay (B.Sc., 2022) and have worked as an Assistant Officer at SIOT Solutions — Southern Innovation of Technology since January 2025.

I design circuits and PCBs in EasyEDA and write firmware for ESP32 and Arduino-based boards — end-to-end product development from schematic to firmware. My work covers sensor integration over I²C, SPI and UART, power regulation, and IoT connectivity over LoRaWAN, MQTT and Modbus, with Node-RED for dashboards and control.

I'm looking for hardware and embedded engineering roles, in Dhaka or remote, and I'm happy to collaborate on open-source hardware, PCB design and robotics projects. Right now I'm learning more embedded systems, ROS and IoT protocols.
